name: Written Notice to Board of Hiring Prior to Board Approval
description: Written advisory to the Board of the need to use a professional or support employee before Board approval; the hire may proceed if no more than two Board members object.
deadline: Before the employee is used prior to Board approval
quote: so long as the Superintendent or designee has advised the Board in writing of the need to make the hiring and no more than two (2) Board members have objected.
